2. Content Ideas CRUD with category filtering and Quick Inspiration suggestions
3. Asset Manager with file upload support (images and videos up to 100MB)
4. Draft workflow: create → submit for review → approve/reject → post
5. Post Templates CRUD with format, brand style, and logo position
6. Instagram Settings placeholder with 'Coming Soon' message for API integration

8. Privacy flags system implemented for content moderation

context_for_next_testing_agent: Content Worker module fully tested and working. All API endpoints under /api/content-worker/* require Super Admin authentication. The module is accessible via the 'Content' tab in the Franchise Command Centre. Key features: Dashboard stats, Ideas CRUD with category filtering, Assets upload/management, Drafts workflow (create/review/approve/reject), Templates CRUD, Instagram Settings (placeholder). Instagram posting is documented as 'Coming Soon' - not a bug, it's planned for future implementation.

feature_verification_summary.Content Dashboard: Displays 8 stat cards: Total Drafts, In Review, Approved, Posted, Rejected, Total Assets, Content Ideas, Scheduled. Also shows Recent Assets and Content Ideas sections.
feature_verification_summary.Content Ideas: CRUD operations working. Category filtering with 6 categories (Product Demo, Pain Point, Educational, Trust Proof, Feature Spotlight, Trending Topic). Quick Inspiration suggestions available.
feature_verification_summary.Asset Manager: File upload working (images/videos up to 100MB). Search and filter by type. Create Post action from asset.
feature_verification_summary.New Post Form: All fields working: Post Title, Hook, Caption Options (3), CTA, Hashtags, Notes, Schedule. Save Draft and Submit for Review buttons functional.
feature_verification_summary.Review Queue: Status filtering (All Status, Drafts, In Review, Approved, Rejected, Scheduled). Approve/Reject workflow functional with notes.
feature_verification_summary.Posted Content: Three tabs: Posted, Scheduled, Ready to Post. Copy Caption and Mark as Posted actions available. Connect Instagram banner with Configure CTA.
feature_verification_summary.Content Settings: Instagram account name input. Post Templates CRUD with format, brand style, logo position. Workflow settings (Require Approval, Privacy Check toggles).
feature_verification_summary.Navigation: All 7 tabs accessible: Dashboard, Assets, New Post, Review Queue, Posted, Ideas, Settings. Back button to Command Centre working.
